title: Bear Brushes His Teeth
lesson: Brushing our teeth keeps them healthy
summary: Sleepy Bear forgets to brush his teeth, until Bunny and Duck show him a fun counting song to brush.

steps.say: Once upon a time, a big bear ate two sweet cookies.

steps.text: Yum, yum! Now I am sleepy. Good night!

steps.say: Hop, hop! Bunny came by with her toothbrush.

steps.text: Bear, did you brush your teeth?

steps.say: Bunny knew a fun way to brush.
Quack, quack! Duck waddled over to help.

steps.text: Quack! Brush and count with us!
One, two, three. Brush, brush, brush!
One, two, three. Brush, brush, brush!
One, two, three. Brush, brush, brush! Hee hee!

steps.say: Up and down, up and down, they brushed all the sticky crumbs away.

steps.text: Now do the back teeth too. One, two, three!
Brush, brush, brush! Tickle, tickle, tickle!

steps.say: Then Bear rinsed with a big, bubbly splash.
Bear's teeth were clean and shiny.

steps.text: My teeth feel good. Thank you, friends!
Quack! Brush every morning and night.

steps.say: Clean teeth, happy smiles. The end!
